abstract.t: This document registers post-quantum algorithms in the IANA registries defined by [I-D.ietf-cose-cbor-encoded-cert]. It extends the C509 certificate specification with post-quantum cryptography (PQC) signature and key encapsulation algorithms: ML-DSA, FN-DSA, ML- KEM, and the stateful hash-based signature algorithms HSS/LMS, XMSS, and XMSS^MT, as well as with composite ML-DSA and ML-KEM algorithms, which combine a PQC algorithm with a traditional algorithm.
